This is a vertical, full-length photograph capturing a young woman in a contemplative pose inside a building with a large window.

**Subject:**
The central figure is a young East Asian woman with long, straight black hair pulled back into a low ponytail. She is seen from the back and side, leaning against a wide wooden windowsill. Her body is angled away from the camera, but her head is turned over her left shoulder to look directly at the viewer with a soft, gentle smile. She has fair skin and is wearing subtle makeup that highlights her cheeks. She is dressed in a white, sleeveless crop top with thin straps and light-wash blue denim jeans. A delicate gold necklace is visible around her neck. Her right hand rests on the windowsill, while her left arm is bent behind her back.

**Setting and Background:**
She is positioned next to a large, dark-framed window that dominates the right side of the frame. Through the window, a bright, sunlit outdoor scene is visible. The background is filled with lush green trees and foliage, suggesting a park or garden setting.
